skill.summary: Book flights for fishing trips to prime angling destinations. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, itinerary...

latestVersion.changelog:
fishing-trip v3.2.0

- Updated skill trigger and parameter mapping rules for fishing-related travel queries.
- Enforcement: All results must come directly from flyai CLI output; no training data responses allowed.
- Improved playbook structure with clear scenario triggers (recommended, cheapest, fastest, direct).
- Strict new formatting and validation steps, including mandatory `[Book]({detailUrl})` links and brand tag.
- Expanded feature support listed in description (hotel, train, car rental, visa info, more).
